sentences: Starting from finite automata, one can repeatedly add nonnegative counters or place the existing storage inside a stack.
This generates increasingly elaborate valence-system models, including vector addition systems and pushdown systems with counters.
The project asks whether the resulting hierarchy is strict or eventually collapses in expressive power.
The source proposes investigating an analogous construction with integer counters as an initial route.
Separating levels would identify when another layer of storage composition supplies behavior that no combination of the earlier layers can reproduce.
